# 06-fly-machines-cattle.png — prompt

Style (shared series system): landscape 16:9 (1672x941). Warm off-white paper background, charcoal typography and outlines. Accents only from: cobalt blue, vermilion, teal, mustard. Crisp geometric editorial illustration, subtle depth, generous negative space. Minimal LARGE text labels exactly as quoted; icons carry secondary meaning. Causal arrows and containment boundaries. Avoid: dashboards, ornamental circuitry, photorealism, tiny labels, decorative AI glow.

Composition: left side, one elevated rounded-square stamp labeled "OCI IMAGE (THE RECIPE)" in cobalt, shown pressing downward like a rubber stamp. Center: a row of four identical small microVM boxes it has stamped, each labeled "MACHINE", visually interchangeable (identical geometry, teal fill). Right side: an "UPDATE" arrow in vermilion showing a NEW stamp producing a fresh fifth machine while one old machine slides toward a small recycle mark — label "UPDATE = FRESH STAMP, NOT A PATCH". Bottom edge, small mustard footnote row: "STOPPED ≈ PENNIES" and "WAKE: ~100s OF MS". The visual argument: identical disposable stamps from one recipe; nothing is ever repaired in place.
